subject.title: macOS onboarding can finish without working inference and greets new users with a raw auth error

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100288 be the sponsored direction for fixing macOS first-run inference verification, or should the issue be narrowed before implementation lands?
rationale: The bug is real on current main, but the proposed fix adds new GUI flow and gateway protocol surface, which is a maintainer-owned product/API decision.

options.title: Review the linked PR as the fix path
options.body: Keep this issue open and focus review on whether the PR's Connect AI page, setup RPCs, and activation semantics are the desired permanent shape.

options.title: Narrow the issue before landing
options.body: Require a smaller repair that blocks raw first-chat auth failures first, leaving broader Settings and protocol work for follow-up.

options.title: Reject the broad onboarding direction
options.body: Close or redirect the linked PR only if maintainers decide live-tested setup should not be part of macOS onboarding.

recommendation.title: Review the linked PR as the fix path
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and focus review on whether the PR's Connect AI page, setup RPCs, and activation semantics are the desired permanent shape.

likelyOwner.reason: This user introduced the current Crestodian onboarding path and authored the linked implementation candidate.
